observations: The corrected setup fragment loaded its declared MV3 fixture worker in isolated Chromium.
chromiumSandbox was explicitly true; the captured launch command did not contain --no-sandbox.
source_change: runtime-drivers.md now explicitly enables chromiumSandbox; Playwright defaults it to false.
limits: This checks documented setup, not an application journey or store distribution.
The import was mapped from @playwright/test to the same-version installed Playwright library; matching official browser bytes were supplied through a test-owned cache path.

An initial instrumentation check using Browser.getBrowserCommandLine failed because that runtime did not expose it without --enable-automation. The final check used the captured Playwright launch command; the unsupported check is not counted as a pass.

Node browser installation failed certificate-chain verification; curl downloaded the official object with TLS verification enabled, validated length/checksum, and unpacked it outside the repository. No trust checks were disabled.
